title: Racing Tradition
description: A smiling young rider holds tightly to a sheep during the Mutton Bustin’ competition at the 67th annual Roy LeBlanc Invitational Rodeo in Okmulgee, Oklahoma. Held each August, the rodeo is one of the longest-running celebrations of Black rodeo culture in the United States. Mutton bustin' events function as the gateway to the rodeo for children, ensuring that the horsemanship and customs of Black cowboys are successfully passed down to the next generation.
translated_description: 在俄克拉荷马州奥克马尔吉举行的第67届年度罗伊·勒布朗邀请赛牛仔竞技会上，一名面带微笑的年轻骑手在“骑羊大赛”中紧紧抓住一只羊。该牛仔竞技会每年八月举办，是美国黑人牛仔文化历史最悠久的庆祝活动之一。“骑羊大赛”是孩子们进入牛仔竞技世界的入门项目，确保黑人牛仔的马术和传统能够成功传承给下一代。
